label: OpenCode

skills.note: OpenCode's own location. It would also read .claude/skills, but DAW does not make one tool depend on another tool's directory.

commands.body:
Use the `{name}` skill to answer this. Follow it exactly.

$ARGUMENTS
commands.note: OpenCode discovers skills but does not expose them as /name — that is a separate feature reading .opencode/commands/ (plural, per opencode.ai/docs/commands). Without this the installer's own closing line told the user to type /daw-status and the TUI answered that no such command exists.

agents._when_readonly_note: OpenCode's permission keys are read/edit/bash/… — there is no `write`. `edit: deny` already covers write, edit and apply_patch.
agents._v2_permissions_note: This block stays in V1's format, which OpenCode V2 still translates (driven live: 0.0.0-dev-202610280534 turns it into {edit,*,deny}), so one drop-in works under both. V2 reads a file in exactly one format and V1 ignores `permissions`, so emitting V2's here would lose `edit: deny` under V1. V2's rules are added at runtime instead: the plugin's `agent.transform` appends {action:edit,resource:*,effect:deny} and {action:shell,resource:*,effect:ask} to every read-only DAW agent (AgentV2Info.permissions in @opencode-ai/sdk v2 types), and adds daw-module-verifier from the packaged agents/ under a plugin install, which ships no agent files.
agents._model_note: Deliberately NOT emitted: OpenCode resolves a subagent's model through its own config (opencode.json), not the agent file, and no per-agent model key has been driven against the live tool. Same rule as codex: no invented keys.

_v2_tools_note: OpenCode V2 runs only the plugin's default export, `{ id, setup(ctx) }`, and none of V1's hooks; daw.js carries both. V2's tool ids are write, edit, patch and shell (V1's apply_patch and bash), with arguments path, content, oldString/newString and patchText; a namespaced id such as opencode.tool.write is matched on its last segment.

choice_prompt.note: the question tool — header, question, options, and a free answer
